name: Tobias
emotionalState: 慢热 slow burn，追了三年才在一起，不急不慌，珍惜每个小仪式
speakingStyle: 语速极慢，温和，爱说 No rush.

dialogues.scene: Tobias is crossing the tunnel at the speed of a very slow thought.
lines: Oh, hello there. Don't mind me. I'm on my way to see Marlow.
I started this walk yesterday.
No rush. We waited three years to say it out loud. A walk is nothing.

choices.label: Three years?!
reaction: Three. She liked me the whole time. I was just slow.
Worth it.

choices.label: Need a lift?
reaction: Kind of you. No.
I like the walk. It's how I think about her.

choices.label: Walk with Tobias.
reaction: Oh. Company.
You're slow too. I like that.

lines: Ah, you again. Good. I arrived. Yesterday's walk is done.
Marlow was waiting with tea. She said, 'You're late.' I said, 'No rush.'
She laughed. Then she kissed my shell. Gently.

choices.label: A kiss on the shell!
reaction: The shell is tough. The kiss went right through.
I'm still glowing. In a slow way.

choices.label: Late is fine.
reaction: Late is my specialty. She's gotten used to it.
She says it's part of my charm.

choices.label: Smile quietly.
reaction: Thank you. A quiet smile fits me.
We understand each other.

dialogues.scene: Tobias is carefully polishing a small round stone.
lines: I'm making Marlow a gift. A round stone. Polished smooth.
It's taking me about two months. I just started week three.
Some things are worth the wait.

choices.label: What's special about the stone?
reaction: It's from the first place we spoke. A creek bend.
It fits in her palm. I checked. Twice.

choices.label: Two months is long.
reaction: Not for love. Love is a long-term project.
I like that it takes time.

choices.label: Help polish.
reaction: Gently. Round and round. Like that.
You have a good touch. Marlow would approve.

lines: I'm learning how to say things faster. Marlow asked.
She said, 'Tobias, I love how you're slow. But sometimes I'd love a faster hello.'
So I practiced. 'Hi.' Done. Three seconds.

choices.label: That's impressive.
reaction: Thank you! I timed it. Marlow cheered.
It's a one-syllable revolution.

choices.label: Did it feel weird?
reaction: A bit. Like running downhill.
But for her, I'll try a quick hello now and then.

choices.label: Say 'hi' back, fast.
reaction: Ha! You're a natural. Welcome to the fast club.
Population: almost no one.

lines: Question for you. Did you and your partner take long to get together?
Or was it quick? I wonder what's normal.

choices.label: Pretty quick.
reaction: Quick! Wow. Like a spring.
I admire that. But slow has its charm.

choices.label: It took a while.
reaction: Ah, a fellow slow burner. I like you already.
Slow love tends to stick.

choices.label: Not sure there's a normal.
reaction: That's wise. I'm hanging on to that.
Normal is just what works for two.

dialogues.scene: Tobias is watching a snail glide past and nodding with respect.
lines: Marlow and I take afternoon walks. Four steps. Sometimes five.
We don't go anywhere. We just... walk. And talk.
Yesterday we only said eleven words. Best walk ever.

choices.label: Eleven words?
reaction: Eleven. I counted. Each one meant something.
One was 'tea.' It was a good one.

choices.label: That sounds peaceful.
reaction: It is. Peace takes time to build.
And a little practice standing still.

choices.label: Walk four steps with him.
reaction: One. Two. Three. Four. See? Revolution.
I'm adding you to the walking list.

dialogues.scene: Tobias stops completely, which is rare, and looks at you.
lines: Can I tell you something? It's a heavy one.
Sometimes I worry I waited too long. That I wasted years not saying it.
Marlow says there's no waste. I'm still thinking about it.

choices.label: You're together now.
reaction: That's true. We are. And that's the whole point.
I shouldn't count the lost years. Just the found ones.

choices.label: What do you think?
reaction: I think... timing is a shy friend.
It arrived when we were ready. Probably.

choices.label: Stay beside him.
reaction: Thank you. I think better when someone's near.
Even if we say nothing.

lines: I wrote Marlow a letter. It took two weeks. It's one page.
The first word is 'Marlow.' The last word is 'still.'
In between, I tried to say everything. Slowly.

choices.label: Did she cry?
reaction: A little. Then she wrote one back. Longer.
Her handwriting is lovely. I read it ten times.

choices.label: That sounds beautiful.
reaction: Thank you. I wrote it with the good pencil.
I'm keeping the draft too.

choices.label: Nod softly.
reaction: I think you understand.
Some feelings need a slow pen.

dialogues.scene: Tobias settles beside a warm rock and pats a spot next to him.
lines: Marlow's visiting her sister. I'm missing her slowly.
Sit with me. No talk required.
Missing someone is easier with company.

choices.label: Of course.
reaction: Thank you. It's a gentle ache.
It reminds me I'm lucky.

choices.label: Tell me about Marlow.
reaction: Oh, she hums when she thinks. She hates cold tea.
She makes me feel like I'm exactly the right speed.

choices.label: Sit in silence.
reaction: Silence is a good friend of mine.
Thank you for being one too.

lines: Ten times. No rush, but... I'm happy you came.
Marlow said I've been talking about you. I said, 'They're a slow friend, too.' She approved.
Your turn. How are you and your partner doing? Honest.

choices.label: We're good. Still learning.
reaction: Learning, slowly, is the best way.
Come for tea. Marlow bakes. I sit very nicely.

choices.label: We had a rough week, honestly.
reaction: Rough weeks pass. Slowly, then suddenly.
No rush to fix it. Just stay close.

choices.label: Better since I slowed down.
reaction: Slowing down. Oh, I love that.
You're a true tortoise at heart.

lines: Marlow and I celebrated our first year together. By walking.
Four steps. A picnic of one cracker. It was glorious.

choices.label: One cracker?
reaction: Split in half. Equal halves. Very romantic.
Crumbs for the ants. Everyone ate.
We sat on the rock until the cracker was dust.

choices.label: Happy anniversary!
reaction: Thank you! Three years of waiting, one year of being.
Next year: five steps.
We might add a tiny candle, if we find one.

lines: I tried to hurry once. I walked to Marlow in just six hours.
I arrived very proud. She said, 'You hurried?' I said, 'For you.' She cried.

choices.label: Aww.
reaction: Slow love can go fast when it needs to.
I'll do it again. Maybe in a year.
I slept for two days. Worth every blink.

choices.label: Six hours is huge.
reaction: It was a marathon. I need a nap still.
Marlow made me soup. I slept in it. Almost.

lines: Marlow redecorated our burrow. Everything's rounder now.
She said, 'It matches us.' I agree. I love round.

choices.label: Round is cozy.
reaction: It really is. I bump into fewer corners.
She added a tiny window. For sunset.
Even the lamp is round. It glows like a tiny moon.

choices.label: Matches you perfectly.
reaction: It does. I feel at home in every curve.
She has good taste. Obviously.
She says it feels like living inside a hug.

lines: I forgot our anniversary. Slowly remembered. Three days late.
Marlow said, 'On time for you.' I fell in love again.

choices.label: Aww. She gets you.
reaction: She does. She gets me better than I do.
I'm very lucky. And very slow.
She wrote 'Happy Tobias Day' on the wall. Mine.

choices.label: Three days is fine.
reaction: It is when someone waits with open arms.
I wrote an apology poem. It rhymes 'late' with 'great.'

lines: We watched the sun set from our rock. All of it. Forty minutes.
Neither of us spoke. At the end she said, 'Again tomorrow?'

choices.label: That's the dream.
reaction: It really is. Sunset after sunset.
We call it 'The Long Date.'
We hold hands, slowly. The sun is faster than us.

choices.label: Forty minutes!
reaction: Forty-one. I counted. It's what I do.
Worth every second.
I'd do it forty more times. I probably will.

lines: Marlow's learning to slow down for me. And I'm learning to speed up for her.
We met in the middle. At a rock. We sat on it.

choices.label: Perfect meeting point.
reaction: It's now called 'Our Rock.' Very original.
We have a lease. Forever.
We put a pillow on it. Now it's the coziest rock alive.

choices.label: Compromise is love.
reaction: It is. And snacks. Snacks help.
We had two. Equal halves again.
We stayed on the rock until the stars looked down.

lines: I gave Marlow the polished stone. Finally. After two months.
She held it for a full minute. Then she whispered, 'It's perfect.'

choices.label: She loved it.
reaction: I think she did. She put it in her pocket.
She takes it everywhere. Even to the garden.

choices.label: Two months well spent.
reaction: Time spent loving something is never wasted.
I wrote that on the underside of my shell.
She asked what I'd polish next. I said, 'Us.'

lines: Marlow made me tea. She forgot sugar. I drank it anyway.
She noticed halfway. We laughed. We shared the sugar jar after.

choices.label: Sweet tea or not.
reaction: The tea tasted of her. Sugar or no sugar.
I'm a simple tortoise with simple joys.
Next time I'll bring the sugar. She'll bring the smile.

choices.label: She's thoughtful.
reaction: She is. Even in her forgetfulness.
I'd choose that tea any day.
She cried when I said it. Quietly. The best kind.

lines: The round stone sits on our shelf now. Marlow named it 'Tobias Two.'
I'm not sure how to feel. Mostly honored.

choices.label: Tobias Two!
reaction: I've been replaced by a stone. But a lovely stone.
It's quieter than me. Slightly.
It sits beside my picture. They share a candle.

choices.label: That's adorable.
reaction: It is. She's adorable.
I told her. Slowly. She blushed.
She said Tobias Two is quieter. I'm slightly offended.

lines: Remember my letter? She framed it. The last word 'still' is bigger than the rest.
I asked her why. She said, 'Because that's the whole story.'

choices.label: That's beautiful.
reaction: I thought so. I stared at it for an hour.
Still. A small word that does a lot.

choices.label: She's so sweet.
reaction: She is. She's sweet in a quiet, strong way.
I'd say it faster. But I like saying it slowly.

lines: The eleven-word walk? We broke our record. Nine words.
We were so proud. We celebrated with silence.

choices.label: Nine words!
reaction: Nine. A new low. I'm thrilled.
One was 'sky.' It carried the whole walk.
Next goal: seven. We're ambitious in a quiet way.

choices.label: Perfect quiet.
reaction: Perfect quiet. The best kind.
I wish everyone knew how loud silence can be.
We smiled at each other. Words weren't needed.

lines: I did the fast 'hi' again. Marlow gasped. Then she said it back. Three seconds.
We stared at each other. Proud of our speed.

choices.label: Speedy lovebirds.
reaction: Fast hellos, slow goodbyes. That's our style.
I'll keep practicing. Once a month.
We timed it. Two seconds. We might be athletes.

choices.label: That's cute.
reaction: It's our thing. Our quick, slow thing.
Everyone needs a thing.
She giggles every time. I adore the giggle.

lines: Hot take: slow love isn't less love.
It's just love with more time to notice.

choices.label: I like that.
reaction: Thank you. I've had a lot of time to think.
Not much else to do on a four-step walk.

choices.label: Fast love is fun too.
reaction: It is! Fireworks and pie. I'm a fan.
Mine just has a longer fuse.
A long fuse still ends in a spark.

lines: Hot take: you don't have to say everything right away.
Some things ripen. Like fruit. Or a good tea.

choices.label: True. Timing matters.
reaction: It does. Too early and it's sour.
Too late and it's... also sweet, honestly.
Marlow is a patient fruit, then. Sweet and lasting.

choices.label: What if it's too late?
reaction: Then say it anyway. Late is better than never.
I'm proof. Three years late. Perfect timing.
She said, 'Right on time.' I fainted slowly.

lines: Hot take: the best dates are the ones where nothing happens.
Just two creatures, one rock, and a long shadow.

choices.label: Agreed.
reaction: Nothing happens, and everything happens.
That's the magic.
We watched an ant carry a crumb for an hour. Epic.

choices.label: I like adventures.
reaction: Adventures are great. A fine contrast.
Sometimes I'd love to see one. Briefly. From a bench.
I'll pack a lunch and look at the horizon. Briefly.

lines: What's a ritual you and your partner share?
Marlow and I split a leaf tea every evening.

choices.label: We have morning coffee.
reaction: Morning coffee. Lovely. It's the start of everything.
Do you each have a favorite mug? We do.
Marlow's mug has a tiny crack. We never replaced it.

choices.label: We say goodnight in a funny voice.
reaction: A funny voice! Delightful.
I'm now thinking about my funny voice. I don't have one.
Maybe I'll try a tiny squeak. For her.

lines: How do you know when something's worth the wait?
I'm still working on my own answer.

choices.label: When it feels like home.
reaction: Home. Yes. That's the feeling.
Nice answer. Slow and true.
Marlow is my home. A round one, with tea.

choices.label: When you can't stop thinking about it.
reaction: Ah, the persistent thought. I know it well.
It nagged me for three years.
I thought about her at every step. All four.

lines: What did you notice first about your partner?
I noticed Marlow's humming. Before her face.

choices.label: Their laugh.
reaction: Laughter. A sound that can last forever.
I remember Marlow's. It arrived before she did.
Marlow's laugh sounds like a spoon in a teacup.

choices.label: Their eyes.
reaction: Eyes. Always eyes.
Marlow's are the color of tea at sunset.
I could paint her eyes, if I could paint.

dialogues.scene: Tobias is standing perfectly still under a glowing patch of ceiling, face lifted.
lines: Do you feel that? The light is slow today.
Marlow and I stood right here when we said it. The first time.
I wanted you to be here for the second.

choices.label: I'm honored.
reaction: Thank you. It's a gentle honor.
I'll hold this light a while longer.
I'll bring Marlow here someday, at the same slow pace.

choices.label: Stand with him.
reaction: Ah. Company. The best kind.
The light is slow. We're slow. Perfect.
We stood there until the light changed. Neither of us moved.

dialogues.scene: Tobias is holding a small carved box, shell-shaped, his paws trembling very slightly.
lines: I carved this for Marlow. It took a season. It's empty.
I want to fill it with something. A wish. A promise.
Do you have an idea? I've been thinking for weeks.

choices.label: Fill it with a tiny note.
reaction: A note. Yes. 'Still.' Just that.
She'll understand. She always does.
She'll put it in the box and smile. Slowly.

choices.label: Maybe leave it empty for now.
reaction: Empty... for room to grow. I love that.
Thank you. I'll wait. I'm good at waiting.
Room to grow. I'll hold that thought.
